questions.text: Which symbol starts a formula in a spreadsheet cell?  A) =  B) #  C) @  D) &
What does SUM(A1:A5) add up?  A) A1 and A5 only  B) Cells A1 to A5  C) All of column A  D) Rows 1 to 5 of every column
Which chart suits shares of a whole at one point in time?  A) Line chart  B) Scatter plot  C) Pie or stacked bar  D) Histogram
What does a filter do to rows that do not match?  A) Deletes them  B) Hides them  C) Sorts them to the bottom  D) Locks them
What is the mean of 2, 4 and 9?  A) 4  B) 5  C) 7.5  D) 15
Which of these is a relative cell reference?  A) $A$1  B) A1  C) $A1$  D) 'A1'
Which function gives the middle value of a sorted list?  A) MEAN  B) MEDIAN  C) MODE  D) MAX
What happens if one column of a table is sorted on its own?  A) Rows stay intact  B) Values no longer line up with their rows  C) Duplicates are removed  D) The header is frozen
What does a pivot table do?  A) Summarises rows by group  B) Rotates the sheet  C) Checks spelling  D) Protects the file
What does $B$2 do when a formula is copied down a column?  A) Stays on B2  B) Moves down a row each time  C) Moves across a column each time  D) Deletes cell B2
COUNT counts the cells in a range that contain  A) Anything  B) Text  C) Numbers  D) Formulas only
Where does VLOOKUP look for its lookup value?  A) Any column of the range  B) The first column of the range  C) The last column of the range  D) The header row
